name: Hamatonbetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hamatonbetsu town emblem in white: a broken ring with a small point at the top, forming a stylised letter G.
history: Municipal flag of Hamatonbetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 12 January 1952.

features.role: Hamatonbetsu town emblem — a broken ring with a small point at the top, forming a stylised letter G
